English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #misleading#hundredrupeenote Has it found the real couple in the hundred rupee note? Misleading The real photo of the couple on the one hundred rupee note in use in this country has been found and a photo of that note and another couple is being shared on social media. by Anonymous | January 8, 2023 Fact Seeker observed that many people have shared and commented on this saying, “That’s what happened…don’t pretend you didn’t see it”. In this regard, Fact Seeker revealed that the hundred rupee note has been edited. The real Rs 100 note has a picture of a dancing Tamil couple. But for this note, a photograph of a young man who recently became famous for a dance was used. Accordingly, this is an edited fake note and Fact Seeker confirms that the information being published as the one hundred rupee note is false.
